# github_enterprise_cost_center (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a specific GitHub enterprise cost center.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "github_enterprise_cost_center" "example" {
  enterprise_slug = "example-enterprise"
  cost_center_id  = "01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cost_center_id` (String) The ID of the cost center.
- `enterprise_slug` (String) The slug of the enterprise.

### Read-Only

- `azure_subscription` (String) The Azure subscription associated with the cost center.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) The name of the cost center.
- `organizations` (Set of String) The organization logins assigned to this cost center.
- `repositories` (Set of String) The repositories (full name) assigned to this cost center.
- `state` (String) The state of the cost center.
- `users` (Set of String) The usernames assigned to this cost center.
